tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures indicate both sink inhibition and coupled transient memory. An extra trajectory batch is needed to distinguish and fit their contributions before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a coupled siphon-memory model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not reliably identify the coupled transient and sink-gradient parameters; the archive also calls for at least eight rows for the memory ODE alone.
The coupled transient-lag signature and variation in x_now and mem_conv leave a dynamic contribution unresolved.
It does not target the identified mechanism ambiguity.
